assessments.reasoning: The NIST official legacy archive hosts the NBS publication. Its title and foreword identify the committee materials and their original approved release dates. The captured complete source exactly matches the registered digest ed60a71b77cb98a49267334b38fc334a7fcf4365dd593a8e467ac83ba363b780. The identified controlling passage is Part I (MDC/28), §1.2.2 Routine Structure, printed page 1-1 / PDF page 15. The MUMPS narrative specification in NBS Handbook 118 describes a routine as a sequence of lines. A line can have a label for control transfer. The claim concerns routine structure for that specification rather than later revisions or implementation file organization. The overview separately defines possible label forms and the dynamic syntax discussion accounts for control transfer and indirection.
